title: Desktop Offline Bundle Install Policy
description: Archive/executable extension blocklists and zip-bomb size caps enforced by apps/desktop-client/electron/bundle-verify.ts (M04) when importing an Offline Bundle. Read directly (not via TypeScript source parsing) by apps/portal-api/src/portal_api/routers/admin.py (M02, P15 관리자 설정) so both modules share one contract instead of M02 coupling to M04's source formatting (CLAUDE.md 원칙 2/3).

archive_extensions.description: Lowercase, dot-prefixed archive extensions treated as forbidden nested archives inside an Offline Bundle.

executable_extensions.description: Lowercase, dot-prefixed extensions classified as executable/code and forbidden inside an Offline Bundle.

max_total_uncompressed_bytes.description: Zip-bomb defense: total uncompressed bytes allowed across the whole bundle.

max_single_file_uncompressed_bytes.description: Zip-bomb defense: uncompressed bytes allowed for any single entry.

max_compression_ratio.description: uncompressed/compressed ratio above which an entry is treated as a suspected zip bomb.

min_ratio_check_bytes.description: Entries smaller than this (uncompressed) are exempt from the compression-ratio check.
